# devcontainer-gen

> Generate devcontainer.json for Python, Node and Go projects from marker files, with versions from version files, an overridable image table and golden output Python package `devcontainer-gen`, import name `devcontainer_gen`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
